# Æion Core

A local web application that takes a feature from brainstorm to an AxiomSpec specification and the feature file aeion-observability builds, with cited documentation.

Project `PROJECT-001` · mode **product** · owner Product owner

## Goals

<a id="goal-001"></a>
### GOAL-001 Brainstorm a feature until it survives review (active)

The Elephant questions the owner's idea until a hypothesis is anchored; seven fresh Goldfish review it and a brief is saved.

Success measure: A brainstorm ends with a saved brief whose analysis names every reviewer, completed or not run.

Requirements: [REQ-006](requirements.md#req-006), [REQ-007](requirements.md#req-007), [REQ-008](requirements.md#req-008), [REQ-009](requirements.md#req-009)

<a id="goal-002"></a>
### GOAL-002 Specify a feature the build factory can implement (active)

A feature document becomes AxiomSpec obligations that pass the template's gates, then an export aeion-observability accepts.

Success measure: Every exported feature file loads in the build factory's catalog with its contract current.

Requirements: [REQ-010](requirements.md#req-010), [REQ-011](requirements.md#req-011), [REQ-012](requirements.md#req-012), [REQ-013](requirements.md#req-013), [REQ-014](requirements.md#req-014)

<a id="goal-003"></a>
### GOAL-003 Answer documentation questions with checkable citations (active)

Every document is findable, and the assistant answers only from evidence its tools returned.

Success measure: Every citation in an answer links to a page section or graph node returned in that run.

Requirements: [REQ-015](requirements.md#req-015), [REQ-016](requirements.md#req-016)

<a id="goal-004"></a>
### GOAL-004 Run model work as checked agents (active)

Each model task is a dedicated Flue agent whose results are validated by code; the key stays in the server.

Success measure: No stored value comes from an agent without passing its schema and checks.

Requirements: [REQ-001](requirements.md#req-001), [REQ-002](requirements.md#req-002), [REQ-003](requirements.md#req-003), [REQ-004](requirements.md#req-004), [REQ-005](requirements.md#req-005)

<a id="goal-005"></a>
### GOAL-005 Keep the local application safe (active)

The server answers only this machine, refuses cross-site writes and never returns secrets or unsafe markup.

Success measure: Every security test of the engine passes.

Requirements: [REQ-017](requirements.md#req-017), [REQ-018](requirements.md#req-018), [REQ-019](requirements.md#req-019), [REQ-020](requirements.md#req-020)
